collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A villager who dreams of cooking well burns everything, and a friend waits with a bowl: eat it anyway, or ask for help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) dreams of being a wonderful cook. (subject.He/she) loves food, loves feeding people, and loves the idea of everyone gathering around something (subject.he/she) made. Unfortunately, (subject.he/she) burns things. Not sometimes. Always. Tonight it's a fish. It's black on one side and raw on the other. (friend) is sitting there with a bowl.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

choices.label: Ask for Help with the Fire

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (friend) eats the good bits and says they're nice, and they are, sort of. (subject) laughs and admits it's a disaster. They end up cooking a second fish together, with (friend) watching the fire, and it comes out fine. (subject) still burns things. (subject.He/she) still loves cooking. Both are true.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) asks (friend) what (subject.he/she) is doing wrong. "Your fire's too hot," says (friend). "You keep feeding it." (subject) had no idea. (subject.He/she) tries a smaller fire the next night, and the fish comes out only slightly burnt. (subject.He/she) is overjoyed. It's not wonderful cooking yet. It's a long way from always.
